body:
Macy's gift cards are supported as part of the gift card payment option at One Stop Vape Store, and they earn the 10% discount. If you shop at Macy's already, or you prefer to buy a card from a large, familiar retailer instead of using cryptocurrency or a payment app, this is a straightforward choice. This guide explains how to buy an e-gift card, which details to copy, how to upload them through our private link, how to match amounts, what happens after we verify the card and how to keep your card protected. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Buy an e-gift card
Open the official [Macy's gift card page](https://www.macys.com/shop/gift-cards) and choose an e-gift card for the exact amount due. Send it to your own email address. The amount due is in our order email, and the order summary shows it before you place the order. Use Macy's own site, or a retailer you trust, because cards from marketplace sellers may be stolen or already used. If you prefer a physical card, buy it in a store and keep the receipt.

## What to copy
The delivery email includes a card number and a PIN. Copy both, and take a screenshot of the email in case you need to resend it. A Macy's card number is long, and the PIN is shorter, so check each digit carefully. If you bought a physical card, the number and PIN are on the back, sometimes under a scratch-off strip. Read the instructions on the card before you reveal the PIN, and take clear photos.

## Upload
Go to the private link in our order email. Add the card number and PIN to the code field, and attach your screenshot and receipt. Submit. The link contains a unique token, so only someone who has it can open the page, and uploads are private. See [how to upload a payment screenshot](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/) for tips on clear images. If you bought more than one card to reach the amount, add each number, PIN and receipt.

## Matching amounts
If the amount you want is not offered, buy the next amount up and tell us in the notes so we can review it. If the amount due is larger than the maximum for a single card, buy two or more and upload them all. Please do not buy a much larger card than you need, because we cannot return unused balance to you.

## Security notes
Do not use the card in-store or online yourself. Do not share it with anyone other than through our private link. Never post a number or PIN in a public chat or on social media, and ignore messages that ask you to pay with a gift card outside our order. Learn more in [gift card code security tips](/blog/gift-card-code-security-tips/).

## After we verify
We confirm the balance, mark the order paid and email you. This is a manual check by our team, so it is quickest during business hours, Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. The order then enters processing, which takes 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse. It ships with tracking by a regional carrier according to the [shipping policy](/shipping/), and an adult aged 21 or older must sign on delivery. See [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/) and [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/).

## A worked example
Suppose your cart is $200. Paying with a gift card applies the 10% discount of $20.00, so the product total is $180.00. Because that is under $200, the flat $15 shipping fee applies, and the amount due is $195.00. Macy's e-gift cards are offered in set amounts, so you might buy a $200 card and tell us in the notes. You upload the number, PIN and receipt through the private link. For comparison, the same cart paid by Chime has no discount, but because $200 meets the free-shipping threshold, the total is $200.00. The comparison shows why it helps to check the order summary: the gift card is still $5.00 cheaper, even though shipping is added. See [the 10% crypto and gift card discount](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/).

## Common problems
### The card is not accepted
Check that you entered both the number and the PIN, and that each digit is correct. If it still fails, contact us with your order number and a screenshot of the receipt.

### The balance is lower than expected
If the card was used or partly used, tell us right away. We will let you know what is needed, which may be a second card.

### I cannot find the email from Macy's
Check spam, check the address you entered when buying and use the order confirmation from Macy's to resend it.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Can I use a Macy's card I already own?
Yes, if it is unused, you own it and the balance matches the amount due. Do not use any of the balance first.

### Is a Macy's card slower than crypto?
Usually, because a person checks each card. See [gift card or crypto, which is better](/blog/gift-card-vs-crypto-which-is-better/).

### What if the card is a physical card?
Photograph both sides, including the number and PIN, and your receipt, and upload them through the private link. Keep the card until we confirm.

## More cards
Not a Macy's shopper? Try [Apple](/blog/pay-with-apple-gift-card/), [Sephora](/blog/pay-with-sephora-gift-card/) or [paysafecard](/blog/pay-with-paysafecard/).

## Related guides
Start with [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/). Browse the [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) range when you are ready. All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Understanding fixed denominations
Gift cards are sold in set amounts, and that shapes how you plan a Macy's gift card payment. Start from the amount due in our order email, then look at the amounts the seller offers. If the exact figure is there, buy it. If not, you have three sensible options. The first is to buy the next amount up and tell us in the notes, which keeps the purchase simple at the cost of a small surplus that we cannot return. The second is to combine two cards that add up to the amount, for example one larger card and one small one, and upload both. The third is to adjust your cart slightly, adding or removing an item so that the amount due lands on an available denomination, which you can do before you pay by contacting us. Whichever you choose, tell us in the notes so that the person verifying your payment knows what to expect. Mismatches that are explained up front are resolved quickly, while unexplained ones take longer.

## Planning the timing of a Macy's gift card order
A gift card order has two phases, and it helps to plan around both. The first phase is yours: buying the card, finding the details and uploading them, which usually takes ten to twenty minutes if you have a payment method ready. The second phase is ours: a person checks the card and matches it to your order, which is quickest during business hours, Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. If you place the order in the evening, buy the card straight away and upload it, and expect the check the next business morning. If you place it on a Friday afternoon, expect the check on Monday. Orders begin processing only after the payment is confirmed, so the sooner you upload, the sooner the 24 to 72 business hours of processing start. Unpaid orders may be released after 24 hours, so do not leave the purchase until the last minute.

## Number and PIN: why both matter
A Macy's gift card has a card number and a PIN, and we need both to verify the balance. Enter the number first and the PIN second in the code field, and double-check every digit. If you bought a physical card, the PIN may be under a scratch-off strip on the back. Reveal it gently and photograph both sides straight away. If you bought an e-gift card, a screenshot of the delivery email is enough. If either part is unreadable in your image, we will ask you to resend it, which slows verification down. Never use any of the balance in-store or online before we confirm your payment.

## A final checklist for a Macy's gift card payment
1. Buy from Macy's official gift card page.
2. Send it to your own email.
3. Copy both the number and the PIN.
4. Upload both, plus the screenshot and receipt, through the private link.
5. Do not use any balance yourself.

If everything on the list is ticked, your payment should be verified without any questions. If something is unclear, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) or WhatsApp before you upload, and we will help. Remember that all products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

### Can I split the amount across two Macy's cards?
Yes. Upload both numbers and PINs with both receipts, and tell us in the notes that the payment is split. We add the balances together when we verify the order.

### What if the card arrives late?
E-gift cards normally arrive within minutes. If yours is delayed, check spam and the address you entered, and use the order confirmation from Macy's to resend it. Do not upload anything until you actually hold the card details.
